_comment: Catalogue number -> archive metadata, for stock that is live on eBay/Depop but not yet written up in src/data/collections.js. Keys are lowercase catalogue numbers (the 'DS-01' in an eBay SKU of 'TA-DS-01'). Anything here overlays the curated catalogue; anything with no record lands in Basic Stock with its garment and colourway inferred from the listing title. Keys beginning with _ are ignored.

_example.name: Cable-Knit Lambswool Slipover
_example.story: One or two sentences of provenance.
